name: loose-tags
summary: Free-form tag input (type to create tags) with async suggestions. The Tag family's input member; home of the teal pills.

type.note: [element] obs-tags: loose (free-create teal pills — type + Enter; optional `suggestions`) | select (pick only from a fixed `options` list → neutral chips)

options.note: [element] obs-tags (type=select): the fixed option list — `value:Label,…` comma string or JSON [{value,label}]

suggestions.note: [element] obs-tags (type=loose): optional autocomplete suggestions — comma string or JSON array

loading.note: [element] obs-tags (type=select): chevron → spinner while options load

asDropdown.note: searchable FlotoDropdownPicker mode (covered by DropdownPicker spec)

singleSelection.note: caps to 1 — ONLY effective in asDropdown

counter.note: { key } scopes suggestion fetch; watched (refetch on change)

placeholder.note: ONLY used in asDropdown (F1); editable mode hardcodes 'Add Tags'

sm.note: DEAD — drives size computed that is never bound (F3)

modes.default: MSelect mode=tags + .loose-tags-input — type-to-create + suggestions; normalizes lowercase+trim+dedupe
modes.asDropdown: FlotoDropdownPicker as-input searchable multiple (DropdownPicker spec); trims, preserves case

accessibility.semantics: Ant Select mode=tags (combobox); Enter add, Backspace remove last, Arrows navigate
accessibility.clear: native clear hidden via CSS (selection__clear display:none)

do: Use to capture a list of free-form or known tags (v-model an array).
Pass :counter to scope suggestions; use disabled for read-only display.
dont: Don't rely on placeholder in editable mode (F1) or sm for sizing (F3).
Don't assume case is preserved — default mode lowercases (F2).
whenToUse: Capturing a list of tags on a form (free-form or from known suggestions).
decisionFlow: Just displaying tags (label/count/status)? -> MTag/MStatusTag, not LooseTags.
Read-only display of an existing list? -> disabled.
Pick from a known/suggested set with search? -> asDropdown.
Free-type to create new tags? -> default (editable).
Only one tag allowed? -> singleSelection (with asDropdown).

editable(default).useWhen: user types values + Enter to add; suggestions offered; lowercased/trimmed/deduped

disabled.useWhen: show an existing tag list read-only (view-mode forms, detail panels)

asDropdown.useWhen: pick from known tags (searchable picker) instead of free-typing

singleSelection.useWhen: only one tag may be selected (caps asDropdown to 1)
singleSelection.note: no effect in default editable mode

counter.useWhen: scope suggestions to a specific entity (dominant real usage)

editable.useWhen: The user should free-type values and press Enter to create tags on a form; existing tags are offered as suggestions. This is the default mode. Values are lowercased, trimmed, and de-duped. v-model is an array of strings.
editable.dontUse: Don't use to pick from a fixed known set with search (use asDropdown), to show a list read-only (use disabled), or just to display a single label/count/status (use MTag / MStatusTag).
editable.example: Adding free-form tags to a monitor (the Monitor tags input).

knownIssues: F1 (medium): placeholder prop ignored in editable mode (hardcoded 'Add Tags'); only used in asDropdown. Bind it on MSelect too.
F2 (low): default mode lowercases tags; asDropdown preserves case — inconsistent normalization.
F3 (low): sm prop + size computed are dead (size never bound) — input always default size.
F4 (low): getAllTagsApi().then() has no .catch — failed/offline fetch is an unhandled rejection (404 pageerror in Storybook). Add .catch → tagOptions=[].

Playground/gallery already cover both types + empty/disabled/loading.

a11y.summary: Type + Enter to add a pill; Backspace removes the last; Arrow keys navigate suggestions, Enter selects. Exposes a combobox/listbox.
issues: Remove × is small — ensure hit target.
a11y.$note: Catalogue-wide gap SF-001 = no visible :focus-visible ring; tracked in findings/.
